caption: The 30 notes of a team base as a graph: projects, people and meetings, joined by their links.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['bases-link-graph'].pro.signOut(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Link Graph/Team graph.base#Graph', '', false); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Hover a note to light up its links and see its name. Click it to open the note.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['bases-link-graph'].pro.signOut(); await app.workspace.openLinkText('Bases Link Graph/Team graph.base#Graph', '', false); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const v = [...app.plugins.plugins['bases-link-graph'].views].filter((v) => v.containerEl.isConnected && v.containerEl.offsetParent !== null && v.graph).pop(); const p = v.screenPos('Bases Link Graph/Notes/Atlas.md'); const c = v.containerEl.querySelector('canvas'); const r = c.getBoundingClientRect(); c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: r.left + p.x, clientY: r.top + p.y, bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return 'ok'; })()
